Legal.pIntro: Myanmar Bible (the mobile app and this website) is a free ministry service with no ads and no subscriptions. This policy explains what information we collect, why, and how you can remove it.
Legal.pCollectBody: You can use the app as a guest: we create an anonymous account with no name or email. If you sign in with Google or with a 6-digit code sent to your email, we store your email address and the name and picture Google shares. We also store what you send us: verse reports, reports about AI answers, Bible requests, your questions in Ask, and a daily count of AI requests (used to enforce free limits). Your highlights, notes, bookmarks, pins, prayers, study guides and reading history stay on your phone; on the website, bookmarks you save are stored with your account.
Legal.pUseBody: We use your information only to run the service: signing you in, answering your questions, fixing reported verse problems, reviewing reported AI answers, and deciding which Bibles to add next. We do not sell your data, we do not show ads, and we do not use analytics or tracking tools.
Legal.pAiBody: When you use Ask, Explain, study guides, the prayer helper or word study, the text you type and the verses involved are sent to Google's Gemini service to produce the answer. Google processes it for us and does not use it to train its models. Your Ask conversations are saved with your account so you can return to them; you can clear them any time in Me → AI settings. You can also switch all AI features off there. Please do not type personal or sensitive details into AI questions.
Legal.pStorageTitle: Where your data lives and who helps us
Legal.pStorageBody: Account data is stored with our database host, Supabase, and is encrypted in transit. Google provides sign-in (if you choose it) and the Gemini AI service. Bible texts and the offline copy of your markers are kept on your device so the app works without internet.
Legal.pDeleteBody: You can export your notes, highlights and bookmarks as a text file, and delete your account at any time from Me → Delete account in the app, or on this website (see the Delete account page). Deleting removes your account, profile, saved Ask conversations, website bookmarks and verse reports permanently. Questions you posted publicly stay, without your name. Data on your phone is removed when you uninstall the app.
Legal.pChildrenBody: The service is suitable for general audiences. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13; a guest account needs none.
Legal.pChangesBody: If this policy changes we will post the new version here and update the date above.
Legal.pContactBody: Questions about this policy or your data: {email}
Legal.tIntro: Thank you for using Myanmar Bible. By using the app or this website you agree to these terms.
Legal.tServiceBody: Myanmar Bible is provided free of charge as a ministry, with no ads and no subscriptions. We strive for accuracy in every Bible text and welcome verse reports from readers.
Legal.tContentBody: Notes, highlights and bookmarks you create belong to you. Verse reports and AI-answer reports you submit may be used to correct the text or improve the service for everyone.
Legal.tUseBody: Do not misuse the service: for example, do not try to disrupt it, get around its limits, automate requests, or submit unlawful or abusive content.
Legal.tWarrantyBody: The service is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind.
Legal.tLiabilityBody: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any damages arising from your use of the service.
Legal.tTerminationBody: You may stop using the service and delete your account at any time. We may suspend accounts that abuse the service.
Legal.tChangesBody: We may update these terms; continued use after an update means you accept the new terms.
Legal.tBibleBody: Each Bible translation belongs to its publisher or is in the public domain; its licence is shown in the app's Bible library. We only offer translations we are allowed to share. Greek and Hebrew word data comes from STEP Bible (Tyndale House, Cambridge), licensed CC BY 4.0. Do not copy the texts for other uses unless their licence allows it.
Legal.tAiBody: AI features help you study; they do not replace the Bible, your church or your pastor. AI answers can be wrong or incomplete. Always check them against the Scripture text, and report answers that are wrong. Free daily limits apply to AI features and may change.
Legal.deleteIntro: You can delete your Myanmar Bible account and its data at any time. This cannot be undone.
Legal.deleteInAppBody: Open Myanmar Bible → Me → Delete account, then confirm. Before deleting you can export your notes, highlights and bookmarks from the same screen.
Legal.deleteWebSignedOut: Sign in with the same Google account or email you use in the app, then come back to this page.
Legal.deleteWebGuest: You are using a guest account. Guest accounts hold no personal information; to remove one, uninstall the app or delete it from Me → Delete account.
Legal.deleteFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again, or email us.
Legal.deleteWhatBody: Your account, profile, email address, saved Ask conversations, website bookmarks, verse reports and quiz scores are deleted permanently and at once. Questions you posted publicly stay, without your name. Highlights, notes and prayers stored only on your phone are removed when you uninstall the app.
Legal.deleteEmailBody: Can't sign in? Email {email} from the address on your account and ask us to delete it. We will do so within 30 days.
